title: PF2e Runesmith Command Deck
description: Complete tactical Command Deck HUD, built-in Impossible Magic Runic Repertoire builder (all 44 Lv 1–17 & Diacritic runes), combat automation (Etch, 1A/2A Trace, smart Engraving Strike weapon selector, Invoke Rune with Class DC saves, level-scaled damage, diacritic modifiers, and turn-based expiry), and Runic Crafter manager for Pathfinder 2e.
